newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to trade Reliance Group options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to trade Reliance Group options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Thursday it would begin trading options on Reliance Group Holdings Inc on March 12.
The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 10, 12-1/2 and 15, with position limits of 7,500 contracts. The stock ended at 11-2/8 Thursday.
Initial expirations have been set for April, May, July and October.
Spear, Leeds & Kellogg has been named the specialist unit. ((-Derivatives desk 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
